disclaimer: Estimated by Ayuvo from your GPS and heart-rate data using published formulas. It is not a clinical exercise test.

sources.acsm: ACSM metabolic equations for walking and running (Guidelines, ch. 6) and %HRR ≈ %VO2R (Swain DP, Leutholtz BC. Med Sci Sports Exerc 1997;29:410-414).
sources.cooper: Cooper KH. A means of assessing maximal oxygen intake. JAMA 1968;203:201-204.
sources.gps: Distance by the haversine formula on the WGS-84 mean radius; accuracy gate and speed gate reject GPS jumps; auto-pause below a sport-specific speed.
sources.hrr1: Cole CR et al. Heart-rate recovery immediately after exercise as a predictor of mortality. N Engl J Med 1999;341:1351-1357 (≤12 bpm abnormal).
sources.keytel: Keytel LR et al. Prediction of energy expenditure from heart rate monitoring during submaximal exercise. J Sports Sci 2005;23:289-297.
sources.trimp: Banister EW (1991); Morton RH et al., J Appl Physiol 1990.
sources.windows: Heart-rate based activity detection: sustained heart rate at ≥50% heart-rate reserve (ACSM moderate intensity) or ≥100 bpm.
sources.zones: American College of Sports Medicine. ACSM's Guidelines for Exercise Testing and Prescription, 11th ed. (2021): % heart-rate reserve and % HRmax intensity classes.
